product.description: With one of the lowest annual fees in the market, and a competitive interest rate, make every day purchases using your Qantas Platinum Credit Card and watch your points soar. Plus, you will also receive up to 55 days interest fee on purchase.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Additional cardholders must be 16 years old

features.additionalInfo: With Bendigo Bank you can turn your phone or smart watch into your wallet. A Wallet includes but is not limited to Google Pay, Samsung Pay, Apple Pay or Garmin Pay, if and when they are available to our customers.

Earn 0.6 Qantas Points per dollar spent, capped at 20,000 per statement period. Refer to the website for exclusions.

Up to 3 consecutive months international insurance cover when at least $500 of prepaid travel costs are purchased with the card. Terms, conditions, limits and exclusions apply, refer to link below for further information.
Cover is activated when you purchase the full value of the covered item with your card
Up to 90 days on stolen or accidentally damaged purchases when the total cost is charged to your credit card

Purchase the total value of your return domestic travel ticket (and your spouse’s and dependants’ if they’re travelling with you) on your card. You may have cover if your domestic flight is delayed, your luggage is lost or you’ve had to cancel your trip due to illness, injury or death of a relative.
The cover is activated when you take legal control of the hire car and the entire rental cost is charged to your card
